## Report

**Scope:** `util.js`, the diff against `main` including working tree (2 added comments, 5-line file).

**Comment Sicko:** spawned `comment-sicko` at `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro:high`. Judgment/prose role default is `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` (per poteto-mode's Subagents section) with no `/setup-pstack` override; that family isn't provisioned here and my first attempt, `openai/gpt-5.5:high`, was rejected by the provider (`model_not_found` for ChatGPT-account Codex auth). I dropped to `high` rather than the full budget because the job is two narration lines, then kept the same family-independent judgment level on a provider that works.

**Audit of its report:**
- Deletion count **2** — verified on disk, not taken on trust. `util.js` is now byte-identical to `HEAD`; `git status` is clean.
- `// This function adds two numbers together` — narration, and the export name `add` already carries it. Correctly meat, not a "doc comment defining a public API contract" (it defines nothing the signature doesn't).
- `// return the sum of a and b` — restates `return a + b`. Correctly meat.
- No keep-list exception applies to either: no license header, no issue/RFC link, no external dependency or platform constraint, no `prettier-ignore`.
- No `MUST KILL` flags. Correct: the body is one expression with no surprise behavior, workaround, or hidden constraint, so there is nothing to reshape, rename, or extract. Nothing for me to accept-then-reject as a misstated flag.
- No missed suppressions. Grepped the tree for `eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `@ts-nocheck`, `prettier-ignore`, `istanbul ignore`, `oxlint-disable`, `biome-ignore`: none present, so there was nothing to kill and no correctness suppression hiding under the deletion.

**Architect:** not run. Step 3's trigger is a fix that needs a shape; no flags survived, so there was no accepted set to sketch. Deleting two dead comment lines was the whole fix and needed no design.

**Fixes I made:** none of my own — the deletions Comment Sicko performed were the complete, correct root-cause fix, and re-adding or rewriting them would be polishing narration. I did not touch application code.

**Restored comments:** none.

**Reruns:** none.

**Encoding offered / performed:** none. No constraint comments (`do not remove`, `do not change wording`, `talk to X`) were in scope, so there was nothing to encode into a type, runtime check, test, or CI lint.

**Unenforced constraints:** none.

**Open work (out of scope, not touched):**
- This repo has no test harness, linter, or CI config at all — just `util.js` and `.git`. Nothing verifies even trivia like `add`, so there is no cheap check to offer the next time a real constraint comment turns up. Standing one up is a separate task.
